A '''Subsidiary computer center''' is where [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|orbital mirrors]] were controlled from the ground.

Prior to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|taking]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] successfully led an assault on [[SCC Number Four]] in order to take down the planet's [[Planetary shield/Legends|shields]].
